# Safety

Roasting produces smoke and heat; the exhaust must be inspected according to [[maintenance#Monthly]].

## Fire

Chaff can ignite. Keep a class D extinguisher next to the roaster and never leave a batch unattended.

## Burns

The drum and the steam wand are hot. Use gloves when emptying the cooling tray.

<div class="warning">Emergency number: 112</div>
